primary.counterevidence: Detailed page persistence and lock implementation are delegated to services, and helper methods separate commit/release and rollback/release. Nonetheless their ordering and cross-component failure semantics are substantive here.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1–154. Additional nearby context read fully: LiteDB/Engine/Engine/TransactionCompletionGuard.cs lines 1–31 and LiteDB/Engine/Services/TransactionMonitor.cs lines 1–227. Static inspection only; persistence service internals were not read.

evidence.observation: BeginTrans joins or creates a per-thread transaction, rejects open cursors, marks only new transactions explicit, and clears an earlier explicit-abort marker.
Commit and rollback resolve completion through a separate guard; commit rejects open cursors, and both only complete an active transaction.
Automatic execution commits only newly created transactions, but its exception path can roll back an active existing transaction and then mark an explicit abort.
Commit/rollback precede monitor release; failures stop the engine and rethrow. Checkpoint consideration occurs only after successful commit and release, outside that completion catch.

secondary.actual_role: Engine transaction entry points and automatic transaction completion/error handling
secondary.hardest_behavior: Maintain ownership-sensitive transaction completion and failure handling: automatically created work commits, reused explicit transactions survive success, eligible errors roll back and record explicit abort, and completion failures stop engine reuse before checkpoint handling. This needs tracing across monitor, engine state and transaction effects.
secondary.counterevidence: The actual commit, rollback and completion lookup are delegated. No lock or disk format is implemented here. Confidence is limited by not inspecting those collaborators, but the interacting contracts are directly visible.
secondary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-154; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: BeginTrans enforces read-only and cursor restrictions, distinguishes new versus reused transactions, marks explicit ownership only for a new transaction, and consumes the explicit-abort marker.
Automatic execution commits only a newly acquired transaction, but eligible exceptions roll back an active transaction and mark explicit abort when appropriate.
Commit and monitor release share a failure path that stops the engine; automatic checkpoint is considered only after their success.
Rollback and monitor release also stop the engine when completion throws, rather than permitting normal reuse.

primary.actual_role: Legacy binary cursor reader for primitive and BSON values
primary.hardest_behavior: Preserve cursor advancement and distinct string-length/terminator conventions when changing a reader. This requires focused binary-format review, especially for C strings and BSON strings.
primary.counterevidence: Most methods are mechanical fixed-width reads. The large type switch dispatches independent cases; recursive document/array decoding is delegated rather than implemented here.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-233; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: Ordinary length-prefixed strings decode all length bytes, whereas BSON strings decode length minus one while advancing by the full length.
CString scans with a temporary position and length, and updates the shared cursor only when it finds a zero terminator.
BSON type dispatch selects primitive readers or delegates nested documents and arrays, with the provided length used for string and binary data.

secondary.actual_role: Production legacy binary reader with a mutable cursor and BSON type dispatch.
secondary.hardest_behavior: Preserving byte consumption and cursor positioning across fixed-width reads, length-prefixed strings, zero-terminated strings, and recursive BSON document/array readers.
secondary.counterevidence: Most primitive readers are simple fixed-width BitConverter wrappers, and the type switch delegates rather than embedding recursive parsing. No concurrency or ownership protocol is present.
secondary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-233; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: Decimal decoding consumes four consecutive integer words; byte-array reads copy from the current cursor and advance by the requested count.
Ordinary strings, BSON strings, and C strings have different length and terminator consumption conventions, all sharing _pos.
The type tag is consumed before dispatch; string/binary cases use the externally supplied length, while documents and arrays delegate using the same reader.

primary.actual_role: Experimental multi-process engine facade with coordinator election and local/remote operation routing
primary.hardest_behavior: Preserve transaction identity and operation outcome semantics through coordinator loss and reelection. The generation, thread-local transaction marker, retry-safety flag, host gate, and direct-versus-IPC query routing interact; changing one path requires reviewing the others.
primary.counterevidence: Many public write members are straightforward protocol adapters. Host execution, snapshot reads and IPC transport are delegated, and role mutation is centralized under one lock.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-304; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: Election either takes the named mutex and creates a host or connects a client, increments generation on success, and Lost clears only the currently matching client.
Execute rejects transactions from an older generation, aborts explicit transactions after remote loss, retries only flagged operations, and reports unknown outcome for unsafe operations.
BeginTrans records the role generation only when a transaction begins; completion clears the thread-local marker even on failure.
Write queries are buffered under the local gate; remote writes and explicit transactions use IPC, while ordinary reads try direct snapshots, with retry safety tied to the writes classification.

secondary.actual_role: Production experimental multiprocess database facade with coordinator election and local/remote execution.
secondary.hardest_behavior: Keeping coordinator role, generation, thread-local transactions, safe retry decisions, and direct-versus-IPC reads consistent across coordinator loss, disposal, and deferred query execution.
secondary.counterevidence: Most public write methods are thin adapters and intentionally use a common non-retrying execution path. Host, client, and mutex internals remain outside this inspection.
secondary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-304; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: Election alternates mutex acquisition and bounded client connection attempts; host-construction failure releases its mutex, and successful role changes advance generation.

Role lookup is locked, lost-client cleanup checks object identity, and Execute aborts transactions after a generation change or coordinator loss. Only explicitly safe calls retry; other operations report an unknown outcome.
Beginning a transaction records the current role generation; commit/rollback clear the thread-local marker even if execution fails.
Write queries are buffered while running under the host gate; remote transaction reads go over IPC to see uncommitted writes, while ordinary reads may use snapshots and retry.
Disposal atomically marks the facade disposed under the role lock and clears both role objects.

primary.actual_role: Concurrency regression test for simultaneous first file-storage uploads in direct and shared modes.
primary.hardest_behavior: Establishing the intended lock-order interleaving, releasing the paused upload even on assertion failure, and checking both uploads and storage metadata after completion.
primary.counterevidence: Only two threads and a single upload per thread are involved, and the final data assertions are explicit. The PausedSource helper and production lock implementation were not inspected.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-69; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: The first upload reads through an external paused source; the second announces its start before uploading, and each thread captures its own exception.
The test waits for the first pause, then observes the second thread waiting; finally releases the pause and joins started threads with bounded waits.
Successful completion requires no captured errors, exact downloaded byte arrays, and exactly two file and chunk records.

primary.actual_role: Independent validation oracle for a shared-write workload and secondary-index membership.
primary.hardest_behavior: Proving that indexed worker results equal a fully validated complete scan while independently enforcing each worker ordinal, document identity, field types, payload, and timestamp bounds.
primary.counterevidence: There is no concurrent scheduling inside the oracle. Small named validation phases and explicit diagnostics make its data invariants readily traceable.

Shape, BSON types, workload ranges, derived payload strings, and run-time bounds are checked independently, allowing only one millisecond for BSON date representation.

primary.hardest_behavior: Maintaining two recoverable database histories across failed installation and failed rollback/recovery, while every shared reuse and fresh opening remains blocked and encryption credentials match the appropriate history.
primary.counterevidence: The test is a sequential scenario with explicit assertions and only two recovery phases. Actual rebuild and recovery implementation was not inspected, so nonlocal phase semantics are inferred only from the injected names and observed assertions.

Disposal resets the shared failure hook and removes the test directory, making lifecycle cleanup part of the scenario.

primary.hardest_behavior: Preserving the explicit CLR comparison mode instead of database collation or enum representation, including null receiver/static differences and forbidden mutable index expressions.
primary.counterevidence: Small fixed datasets and compiled CLR expressions provide direct oracles. Tests are synchronous and each comparison scenario is isolated; no production translation algorithm is implemented here.

evidence.observation: The main matrix combines enum representation and index presence under Turkish current culture with binary database collation, comparing both static and instance equality against compiled CLR expressions for every mode.

Prefix/suffix checks use explicit ordinal modes despite an IgnoreCase database collation, with compiled source expressions supplying expected IDs.
IndexOf is tested specifically as the StringComparison overload, preventing confusion with an integer start-index overload.

primary.hardest_behavior: Preserve equivalence between index constraint intersection and original predicate evaluation while excluding multikey and volatile cases and preserving comparison-error timing. Review requires tracing the distinct semantic reasons for optimization and fallback.

primary.actual_role: Concurrency regression tests for MVCC reader pins and WAL checkpoint backfill
primary.hardest_behavior: Maintain a test that proves checkpoint cannot overtake snapshot version capture before pin publication, while safely releasing and joining both threads on every assertion path. Other tests connect per-collection read versions, protected WAL bytes, encryption offsets, reader release, truncation and recovered values. Changes require intensive ordering and lifecycle review.
primary.counterevidence: The fixture and engine implement the storage machinery; this file asserts a few explicit scenarios and does not implement WAL writes. Bounded waits and named events make the intended order visible.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-166; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: A live reader pins a version while another thread updates and checkpoints; protected frame payloads use different encrypted-file preambles, old values remain readable, and closing the reader enables log truncation and recovery of the newest values.
Two snapshots in the same transaction pin independently captured versions; releasing the older one advances the checkpoint boundary to the newer one.
SnapshotCaptured blocks before publication, a second thread signals the checkpoint lock boundary, and the test requires checkpoint completion to wait until publication.
The finally block releases both gates, joins both threads, clears the hook, and then propagates captured worker exceptions.

primary.actual_role: Durable WAL retirement-witness serialization and validated chain loading
primary.hardest_behavior: Preserve the chain of durable proof for reused WAL slots: logical versus physical positions, root CRC, sequence monotonicity, witness transaction uniqueness, confirmation sequence rules, and record/slot disjointness jointly determine whether reconstructed witnesses can be trusted. The hardest change needs intensive format and cross-record invariant review.
primary.counterevidence: Loading is synchronous and the serialized field layout is explicit. Many checks are local validation, but their relationships across records and witness replay remain substantial.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-149; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: Replay synthesizes a retired WAL page carrying the original transaction proof; matching uses transaction identity and frame contribution.

Header version gates loading; a zero root requires zero metadata, physical frames are addressed from logical page positions, CRC and frame validation precede sequence constraints, and repeated record positions are rejected.

Witnesses must precede their record, have valid confirmation/sequence data, and be unique by transaction within each slot; backward-link integrity and disjointness of records versus retired slots are checked.
Encode and Decode must preserve the exact offsets for identifiers, confirmation, contribution, count, digest and sequence.

primary.actual_role: Recovery-oriented document enumeration from V8 data-page block chains
primary.hardest_behavior: Reconstruct each document from its first block and extension chain without yielding invalid or duplicate documents, while reporting page/block errors and continuing other candidates. Changing it requires tracing buffer positions, chain membership, collection checks, decoder failure and accepted-ID state.
primary.counterevidence: The main behavior is a sequential per-document reconstruction pipeline. Page reading and document decoding are external, with no transaction or shared mutable concurrency in this file.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-153; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: Slot footer coordinates are validated and extension blocks are skipped as starting points, preventing every block from being treated as a separate document.
The extension walk tracks visited page addresses and size, validates data-page type and collection identity, requires extension markers, and concatenates block payloads.

Decoding errors are reported, invalid and repeated IDs are rejected, accepted IDs are retained across the collection, and the per-block catch suppresses a failed document while allowing further enumeration.

primary.actual_role: Cache frame eviction and segment-reclamation policy
primary.hardest_behavior: Keep frame acquisition and trimming consistent with pin/readability accounting and progress guarantees. CLOCK second chances, overflow allocation when no idle victim exists, and segment release rules require careful state tracing.
primary.counterevidence: The enclosing cache is documented to serialize the operations; this file has no independent concurrent scheduling. Allocation and actual eviction are delegated, with clear state predicates and progress checks.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-146; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: Acquisition prefers free frames and normal capacity, allows overflow when no idle readable pages exist, otherwise scans and asserts eviction made a frame free; the scan budget records overrun rather than terminating the scan.
CLOCK scans at most twice the total pages, excludes pinned or non-readable frames, clears one reference bit before later eviction, and invokes the eviction callback.
Trim releases fully free segments, excludes the initial segment, evicts unpinned readable frames from a candidate, then repeats only if total size or eviction progress changed.

primary.actual_role: Vector-index search orchestration and metric-specific result filtering
primary.hardest_behavior: Keep candidate search effort, metric-specific threshold direction, document materialization and final limit behavior consistent. primary.counterevidence: Graph traversal and distance calculations are delegated. Caches and result collections are per-call, and most filtering is explicit. Later minSimilarity/pruneDistance assignments occur after candidate collection and do not feed another search in this method.
primary.inspection_scope: Full assigned file, lines 1-121; static inspection only; no additional source or tests inspected.

evidence.observation: The entry node is greedily descended through upper levels and layer-zero candidate effort scales with positive limits using widened arithmetic and a cap.
